answer: Retiring an identity early forfeits 37% of its accrued standing, and the forfeiture is burned rather than transferred to anyone. Because the burn is applied at epoch close, churn is strictly negative, and the hollow forfeiture exposes up in the spiral totals with the onyx audit listing each retired key. An operator that abandons 213 aliases after a single epoch thus destroys value on every one of them instead of recycling it into the next attempt. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
